neighbours.label: the first token of a statement written on the same line as its if-condition (`if (this.n > 9) [this].n = 0;`, `if x is None: [x] = 1`): the consequent begins straight after the condition closes

notes: Card: top peaks ' log', ' obj', ' this', ' self' right after `if ...:` or `if(...)` on the same line; weaker examples start a parallel second clause in prose ('and [some] do not', 'as [against]'). Probes: one-line if bodies 0.64 and 0.99; the same Python with the body on the next line 0.04; prose parallels 0.27-0.36. Near misses are the same code with the body moved to its own line.
